name: Madeleine Roy
source:
Madeleine is [url=/c148152]Alex[/url]'s workout partner, quick with a joke and very comfortable joining the competition between [url=/c148150]you[/url]. She enjoys getting a reaction from Alex and seems just as happy to involve you. For now, you mostly know her through that friendship.
